ideas.pitch: An IoT-based power monitoring system using ESP32 and current sensors that detects anomalous energy consumption spikes in department labs and provides real-time alerts.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Energy Grid Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Hardware & Software tracks with a low-cost, immediately deployable prototype fits the ECE & EE department vibe of the organizing institution.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision garbage segregation system running locally on a Raspberry Pi using a lightweight model to sort metal, plastic, and organic waste instantly without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: Edge AI Smart Dustbin Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical hardware components with embedded machine learning, echoing proven robotics winning patterns from previous hardware-heavy hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A localized data transmission system leveraging audio frequencies over standard walkie-talkies or speakers to pass short text packets in dead zones where cellular networks fail.
ideas.title: Offline Acoustic Mesh Communicator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Involves unusual physical build and complex signal processing that immediately stands out against standard web apps in a room of college judges.

ideas.pitch: A developer tool running small open-source language models locally via hardware NPUs to scan Python codebases for security vulnerabilities without sending code to external servers.
ideas.title: NPU-Accelerated Offline Code Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages local AI hardware execution and targets the growing demand for secure, offline, privacy-first developer tools.

ideas.pitch: A compact hardware debugging peripheral built on an FPGA development board that captures, decodes, and displays serial communication packets directly on an attached OLED screen.
ideas.title: FPGA-Based UART Protocol Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the ECE & EE organizing departments' core focus on VLSI design and hardware testing, appealing heavily to technical faculty judges.
